# Muto Menu

> Native in-game ModMenu UI integration for Muto Runtime on Fabric 26.x (Minecraft 26.1 - 26.3, Java 25).

## Version & Links
- Version: 0.1.0-beta+26.x
- Site: https://mutomenu.fy2ne.me
- Documentation: https://mutomenu.fy2ne.me/docs
- Source: https://github.com/fy2ne/Muto-Menu
- Required Engine: https://muto.fy2ne.me

## Capabilities
- Injects Enable/Disable, Load, Revert, and filter controls directly into ModMenu ModsScreen.
- Renders disabled (.jar.disabled) mod cards dimmed with a [Disabled] pill and staged changes with [Pending: On/Off] badges.
- Prompts two-click dependency confirmation before disabling shared libraries (warnDependencies).
- Watches .minecraft/mods with ModsFolderWatcher for automatic hot-swaps on JAR drop or deletion.
- Provides MutoModChangesScreen, ReloadHistoryScreen, MutoDevScreen, and atomic config/muto-menu.json settings.
